1.des: Discover Florence, the heart of the Italian Renaissance. Explore world-class museums, stunning cathedrals, and the vibrant streets filled with art, fashion, and history.

itinerary.title: Arrival & Historic Duomo District
itinerary.description: Guided walk through Piazza del Duomo, Cathedral of Santa Maria del Fiore, and Baptistery of St. John.

itinerary.title: Renaissance Masterpieces & Ponte Vecchio
itinerary.description: Priority visit to the Uffizi Gallery, Accademia Gallery, and sunset walk across Ponte Vecchio to Oltrarno.

itinerary.title: Boboli Gardens & Piazzale Michelangelo Departure
itinerary.description: Morning exploration of Palazzo Pitti and Boboli Gardens, panoramic city views from Piazzale Michelangelo, and departure.

2.des: Visit the iconic Sydney Opera House, a masterpiece of modern architecture. Experience breathtaking views of Sydney Harbour and immerse yourself in cultural performances.

itinerary.title: Circular Quay & Sydney Opera House Tour
itinerary.description: Welcome orientation at Circular Quay followed by an architectural guided tour of the Sydney Opera House.

itinerary.title: Sydney Harbour Bridge & The Rocks
itinerary.description: Guided heritage walk through The Rocks district, Royal Botanic Garden, and afternoon Sydney Harbour cruise.

itinerary.title: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
itinerary.description: Scenic coastal exploration from Bondi Beach to Coogee with waterfront dining at Darling Harbour.

itinerary.title: Harbour Ferry & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning ferry across Sydney Harbour for skyline photography and departure transfers.

3.des: Experience the romance of Paris with a visit to the Eiffel Tower. Capture stunning views of the city and enjoy the charm of France’s most iconic landmark.

itinerary.title: Champ de Mars, Trocadéro & Eiffel Tower Ascent
itinerary.description: Guided visit to Trocadéro Gardens, access to the Eiffel Tower viewing levels, and evening Seine river cruise.

itinerary.title: Historic Seine Landmarks & Montmartre
itinerary.description: Morning tour of the Louvre courtyard, Île de la Cité, and the artistic streets of Montmartre.

itinerary.title: Champs-Élysées, Arc de Triomphe & Departure
itinerary.description: Stroll along Avenue des Champs-Élysées to the Arc de Triomphe before afternoon departure.

4.des: Enjoy panoramic views of Hong Kong from Victoria Peak. A must-visit spot offering stunning cityscapes, nature trails, and unforgettable sunsets.

itinerary.title: Peak Tram Ascent & Sky Terrace 428
itinerary.description: Historic Peak Tram ride to Victoria Peak for panoramic views over Victoria Harbour and Hong Kong Island.

itinerary.title: Star Ferry, Tsim Sha Tsui & Harbour Lights
itinerary.description: Harbour crossing on the Star Ferry, Kowloon waterfront promenade, and evening harbour light show.

itinerary.title: Lantau Island & Ngong Ping Highlands
itinerary.description: Cable car journey over Lantau Island, Po Lin Monastery, and scenic mountain walking trails.

itinerary.title: Central Heritage Markets & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning exploration of Hollywood Road and Central street markets before departure.

5.des: Explore the breathtaking Amazon Rainforest. Discover exotic wildlife, lush greenery, and the incredible biodiversity of the world’s largest tropical forest.

itinerary.title: Manaus Arrival & Riverboat Transfer
itinerary.description: Welcome briefing in Manaus and scenic riverboat journey to the Amazon rainforest lodge.

itinerary.title: Meeting of the Waters & Canopy Walk
itinerary.description: Witness the confluence of the Rio Negro and Solimões rivers followed by a guided rainforest canopy walk.

itinerary.title: Flooded Forest Canoeing & Wildlife Spotting
itinerary.description: Canoe excursion through flooded forest channels searching for macaws, sloths, and pink river dolphins.

itinerary.title: Botanical Trail & Nocturnal River Safari
itinerary.description: Guided ethnobotanical walk learning about rainforest plants and an evening wildlife safari.

itinerary.title: Sunrise Birdwatching & Return to Manaus
itinerary.description: Early morning birdwatching along the riverbanks before returning to Manaus for departure.

6.des: Dive into the vibrant culture of Camden Market. Shop unique crafts, fashion, and street food while enjoying London’s most eclectic marketplace.

itinerary.title: Camden Lock, Stables Market & Regent's Canal
itinerary.description: Guided exploration of Camden's craft stalls, international street food, and a walk along Regent's Canal.

itinerary.title: Westminster, Big Ben & South Bank
itinerary.description: Classic London landmarks tour covering Westminster, Big Ben, the London Eye, and Millennium Bridge.

itinerary.title: Tower Bridge, Thames Walk & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Tower Bridge and the Thames riverside before departure.

7.des: Discover the wonders of Komodo National Park. See the legendary Komodo dragons and explore pristine beaches, crystal-clear waters, and rich marine life.

itinerary.title: Labuan Bajo Arrival & Sunset Island Cruise
itinerary.description: Harbour check-in at Labuan Bajo and sunset boat excursion across the Flores Sea.

itinerary.title: Padar Island Sunrise Trek & Pink Beach
itinerary.description: Early hike to Padar Island's panoramic viewpoint followed by snorkeling at Pink Beach.

itinerary.title: Komodo Island Ranger Walk & Taka Makassar
itinerary.description: Guided ranger trek to observe Komodo dragons in their natural habitat and sandbar visit.

itinerary.title: Manta Point Snorkeling & Kanawa Island
itinerary.description: Drift snorkeling at Manta Point and relaxing over the coral reefs of Kanawa Island.

itinerary.title: Labuan Bajo Harbour & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning harbour return and transfer for departure.

8.des: Experience the beauty of Zurich, Switzerland’s cultural and financial hub. Wander through historic streets, enjoy lakeside views, and taste Swiss delights.

itinerary.title: Old Town (Altstadt), Fraumünster & Limmatquai
itinerary.description: Guided walking tour of historic guild houses, Fraumünster, Grossmünster, and Lindenhof hill.

itinerary.title: Lake Zurich Cruise & Bahnhofstrasse
itinerary.description: Scenic boat cruise on Lake Zurich with a visit to local Swiss chocolatiers and Bahnhofstrasse.

itinerary.title: Uetliberg Mountain Panorama & Kunsthaus
itinerary.description: Train ride up Uetliberg for sweeping views of Zurich and the Alps, followed by the Kunsthaus museum.

itinerary.title: Zurich-West Viadukt & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to Zurich-West's historic Viadukt arches before departure.

9.des: Visit the Taj Mahal, one of the Seven Wonders of the World. Marvel at the ivory-white marble and the love story behind this timeless monument.

itinerary.title: Agra Arrival & Mehtab Bagh Sunset View
itinerary.description: Transfer to Agra and evening views of the Taj Mahal across the Yamuna River from Mehtab Bagh gardens.

itinerary.title: Sunrise at the Taj Mahal & Agra Fort
itinerary.description: Guided sunrise tour inside the Taj Mahal complex followed by the UNESCO-listed Agra Fort.

itinerary.title: Fatehpur Sikri Excursion & Departure
itinerary.description: Morning visit to historic Fatehpur Sikri and marble inlay workshops before departure.
